definitions.stable: Registered segment body tokens wholly inside cache_stability==1 text, excluding query/observation/history/scratch, injected headings, outer chat control/system wrapper and boundary-crossing tokens.
definitions.prompt_denominator: All actual API input IDs, including headers and special tokens.
definitions.native_stable_recovery: Counted stable body token positions before the actual native prefix-hit boundary, divided by counted stable body tokens.
definitions.warm: Actual tenant turn-zero business requests, not infrastructure warmup; reported separately.
definitions.source_macro: Mean of source-specific token-weighted stable fractions; pooled token ratio separately reported.

limits: Declared stability is a manifest assumption, not proof that content is public.
Controlled trace statistics do not measure production frequency.
These explicit new denominators cannot recover or validate the missing original percentage provenance.
